confidence_notes: I based the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors on one web search of cost-of-living aggregators (traveltables, expatistan, livingcost and mylifeelsewhere). The sources disagree a lot and were published at different times. I estimated cocktail and wine prices from typical Mexican price ratios to beer rather than finding them directly. All accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge for a July (off-peak, hot season) period, and I did not check any booking pages. The FX figure is the RBA 4pm rate for 18 November 2026, as reported by the RBA site in the search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mérida is a mid-sized colonial city in Mexico that attracts both tourists and expats. Sources put it at roughly 20% cheaper than Mexico City and similar to Oaxaca or Puebla.
